title: Tech View group headers show grip, arrow, avatar, name, pin and count
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-08-tech-view-group-headers-light-1440.png" and "DC-08-tech-view-collapsed-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two technicians are active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role: {Technician-A}, who has a profile photo, and {Technician-B}, who has none. No technician is pinned in your Tech View.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Ines and {Technician-B} is ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has Approved work orders {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A} and {Work-order-2} led by {Technician-B}, and an Estimate {Work-order-3} with no lead technician.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Group Header, and {Work-order-1} to {Work-order-3} are S10043-17821 to S10043-17823.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the "Unassigned" group header from left to right.
  2. Look at {Technician-B}'s group header from left to right.
  3. Look at the avatar in {Technician-A}'s group header.
  4. Hover the number at the right of {Technician-A}'s group header.
  5. Hover the avatar in {Technician-B}'s group header.
  6. Click the pin in {Technician-B}'s group header.
  7. Click the arrow in {Technician-A}'s group header.
  8. Click the same arrow again.
  9. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  10. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  11. Click the pin in {Technician-B}'s group header to unpin it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a thin down-pointing arrow, a round light-grey avatar with a grey outline person icon, the word "Unassigned" in dark semibold text, a short grey divider, a clipboard outline icon and the count, as in the picture. No six-dot grip and no pin.
  • Step 2: the six-dot grip, the arrow, a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (a little darker than in the design picture, not a solid blue circle with white initials), the name in dark slate semibold text about the size of the row text, a grey outline pin that shows without hovering, the divider, the clipboard icon and the count.
  • Step 3: the avatar is the technician's round photo.
  • Step 4: a dark tooltip opens above the number and does not cover any column header label.
  • Step 5: the browser's plain name tip shows {Technician-B}.
  • Step 6: the pin turns blue, as on a pinned Board View column header.
  • Step 7: the group closes and its arrow points right, as in the collapsed picture.
  • Step 8: the group opens again and the arrow points down.
  • Step 9: the headers are shorter and their avatars smaller; the names keep the same size.
  • Step 10: the headers are taller and their avatars larger; the names keep the same size.
  • Step 11: the pin is grey again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View), SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 61 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R11a, S2-R23, S9-R1a, S2-R12, S2-R10, S2-R5 and S1-R9a, read 16 Oct 2026. Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html" (the design pictures named in the preconditions were rendered from it), read 14 Oct 2026. Related tickets: SV-11319, SV-11338. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answer 16, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 16 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026, before the expected results changed on 16 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.

SV-11338 estimates the design's header name at about 16 px; the ticket's estimated design sizes differ from the design file, which draws the name at 14 px semibold; this case follows the design file. Pinning in Tech View: Ahtasham Amjad asked Chris Ward on 14 Oct 2026 whether to keep the pin the PRD keeps (S2-R11) although the design shows none; PRD version 55 (S2-R11a) keeps it, always shown and styled like Board View's, and steps 2, 6 and 11 now check it. The PRD (version 52) also put a grip on the Unassigned header; Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 16) that the Unassigned header has no grip, and PRD version 61 still says so.

PRD versions 55, 58 and 61 (S2-R23) set no-photo initials to a darker grey than the design file (#4B5565 instead of #697586, for contrast), header names slate semibold, and header avatars keep the browser's plain name tip.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R11a: “The pin on each Tech View technician group header is always shown, styled as on Board View’s column headers: grey when unpinned, blue when pinned, and dimmed on unpinned technicians once three are pinned (S3-R8).”
  • S2-R23: “In Tech View and Board View, as in the design: a technician avatar without a photo is a light-grey circle (--sv-grey-100, #EEF2F6) with initials in --sv-grey-600 (#4B5565) in light mode, which meets accessible contrast (6.7:1; the design file’s #697586 is 4.2:1); dark mode uses the design’s dark colors; group and column header names are 14px, weight 600, in the design’s slate text color (#364152), with the design’s smaller, lighter initials; Board card customer and total price are weight 500; toolbar and switcher icons are the design’s slate color (the switcher in List too, S1-R9a). Technician avatars, and the Service Advisor avatar, follow density in Tech View as in the design: 20px, 24px and 32px on rows and 24px, 28px and 36px on group headers at Compact, Regular and Comfortable; Board View card avatars stay 24px. The Progress bar is 48 by 4px at Compact, as in the design. The name bubble on hover over a technician avatar on a row or card (the +N included) opens above the avatar, in both views; group and column header avatars keep the browser’s plain name tip, because the name is printed beside them. In Tech View, Status, Waiting On Parts and Progress are left-aligned. The Density and Columns tooltips open above their button, like the switcher’s (S1-R9b), and are hidden while their menu is open. List is unchanged.”
  • S9-R1a: “In Tech View every work order row, Unassigned’s rows included, shows the design’s six-dot drag grip at its left edge to users who can drag work orders (S4-N1). Every technician group header shows the grip to every user who can reorder technicians (S9-R2), view-only users included, because the technician order is personal. The Unassigned group header shows no grip, because Unassigned cannot move (S9-R8). The whole row still drags (S2-R8); the grip shows that it can.”
  • S2-R12: “Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.”
  • S2-R10: “Hovering a technician header or avatar reveals the technician’s name.”
  • S2-R5: “Allow each technician group to be collapsed or expanded.”
  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View these icons are the design’s: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View, custom icons in the design system’s icon set), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and the empty state when there are no work orders at all (`clipboard-list`). The filtered no-results state is the List’s, magnifier included (S1-N1). The filter chips and Search use the design file’s icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it. The display switcher (new on every view, List included) shows the design’s slate icons in every view, so it keeps one color as the user moves between views. These are the only changes to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), staff avatar: “Photo when we have one, initials otherwise.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), staff avatar without a photo: “background: color || 'var(--sv-surface-sunken)', color: color ? 'var(--sv-accent-on-solid)' : 'var(--sv-text-secondary)',”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View group header name: “font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--sv-text-primary); margin-right: -12px;”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Tech View group header height by density: “groupH: rowDensity === "large" ? "56px" : rowDensity === "small" ? "36px" : "44px"”
